items.check: No hardcoded bridge tokens in extension source or build output
items.method: grep -r 'gemini-bridge-[0-9a-f]' extension-cloudflare/ dist/extension/; also search .zip output for token patterns
items.pass_criteria: Zero matches in source files; zero matches in built extension zip

items.check: Bridge auth token not leaked via browser history, referer headers, or devtools
items.method: Inspect all fetch()/WebSocket URLs for token in query string; verify token sent only via x-bridge-token header or Authorization header, never in URL
items.pass_criteria: Token never appears in URL, history, or referer; sent only via headers

items.check: Error messages do not contain sensitive data (tokens, session IDs, internal paths)
items.method: Grep all error response strings in index.js for variables that could contain secrets; verify error messages use generic strings
items.pass_criteria: No error message template includes token, session ID, or internal file path variables

items.check: Standby tab auto-promotes within 15s when leader heartbeat stops
items.method: Simulate leader tab crash: set isLeaderTab=true, stop sending HEARTBEAT, verify background.js checkLeaderHealth() promotes standby after 15s (3 missed beats at 5s interval)
items.pass_criteria: Standby promoted within 15s ± 1s; new leader sends SESSION_READY; no duplicate active connections

items.check: Server rejects malformed WebSocket messages without crashing
items.method: Send truncated JSON, oversized payloads (>1MB), non-string message type, null payload; verify server returns error response, does not crash or hang
items.pass_criteria: All malformed messages get error response; server stays alive; no DoS

items.check: Prompt/response isolation between tab scopes (app vs notebook vs horo_consult)
items.method: Connect two clients with different scopes; send execution request on scope A; verify response only delivered to scope A tab, not scope B
items.pass_criteria: Cross-scope data does not leak; each scope receives only its own responses

items.check: 11th concurrent request returns 429 when queue is full (concurrent=1, queue=10)
items.method: Send 12 concurrent POST /v1/chat/completions requests with extension disconnected; first request queues, 10 fill queue, 11th+ returns 429 Too Many Requests
items.pass_criteria: 11th and subsequent requests return HTTP 429; first 11 are queued or processed

items.check: Client v4.3.3 (protocolVersion 2) works against server v4.3.4 (supports 2-3)
items.method: Simulate SESSION_READY with protocolVersion: 2 to server; verify server accepts (in range 2-3), returns 200; verify auth-check reports minSupportedVersion: 2
items.pass_criteria: v2 client connects successfully; graceful degradation to legacy mode; no 503 or connection reset

items.check: Extension service worker restart restores connection without 409 or duplicate instance IDs
items.method: Simulate SW restart: destroy socket, clear storage, re-init; verify INSTANCE_ID is regenerated, new SESSION_READY sent, server accepts (old instance timed out via 45s stale cleanup)
items.pass_criteria: No 409 conflict; new instance ID accepted; session restored; no orphaned connections

items.check: Error responses use generic messages, no internal state leakage
items.method: Trigger 400 (bad JSON), 401 (bad token), 503 (no extension), 429 (queue full); inspect response bodies for internal paths, model names, or session details
items.pass_criteria: All error responses contain only generic messages; no internal architecture details exposed
